items.exampleEn: Burial customs differ from country to country.
items.exampleZh: 各國的喪葬習俗不盡相同。

items.exampleEn: Come here, darling, and help me with the cake.
items.exampleZh: 親愛的，過來幫我做蛋糕。

items.exampleEn: The little boy ran to his mama when he saw the big dog.
items.exampleZh: 小男孩看到那隻大狗，就跑向他媽媽。

items.exampleEn: My roommate always leaves dirty dishes in the sink.
items.exampleZh: 我室友總是把髒碗盤留在水槽裡。

items.exampleEn: Good interpersonal relationships make school life much happier.
items.exampleZh: 良好的人際關係會讓學校生活快樂得多。

items.exampleEn: 'Madame, may I carry your bags?' asked the young driver.
items.exampleZh: 年輕的司機問：「夫人，我可以幫您提行李嗎？」

items.exampleEn: Many pop songs are about the pain of a breakup.
items.exampleZh: 很多流行歌都在唱分手的痛苦。

items.exampleEn: Young children learn to socialize by playing in groups.
items.exampleZh: 幼童透過團體遊戲學會與人相處。

items.sentenceEn: Scientists found an old burial site near the river.
items.sentenceZh: 科學家在河邊發現了一處古老的墓葬遺址。

items.audioEn: Madame Martin, your table by the window is ready.
items.audioZh: Martin 夫人，您靠窗的座位準備好了。
items.questionZh: 說話者告訴 Martin 夫人什麼事？

items.sentenceEn: After the breakup of the band, each singer started a solo career.
items.sentenceZh: 樂團解散後，每位歌手都各自展開個人事業。

items.sentenceEn: Madame Dubois teaches French at the language school near my office.
items.sentenceZh: Dubois 女士在我辦公室附近的語言學校教法文。

items.stemEn: My ____ is from Canada, so we often speak English at home.
items.stemZh: 我的室友是加拿大人，所以我們在家常講英文。

items.stemEn: Working from home is convenient, but I miss the chance to ____ with colleagues.
items.stemZh: 在家工作很方便，但我懷念和同事交流的機會。

items.passageEn: When I moved to the city for work, I shared an apartment with a roommate named Paula. At first, we rarely talked, because she preferred to socialize with her own friends. Things changed after Paula's breakup with her boyfriend. She was sad, and I made tea for her every evening. Paula's mama, who calls her "my darling" on every phone call, thanked me for being so kind. Through this experience, I learned that interpersonal skills are not only for work. Now Paula and I share the rent, the cooking, and our stories, and life in the city has become considerably more fun.
items.passageZh: 我因為工作搬到城市時，和一位叫 Paula 的室友合租公寓。一開始我們很少說話，因為她比較喜歡跟自己的朋友來往。Paula 和男朋友分手後，情況改變了。她很難過，我每天晚上都泡茶給她喝。Paula 的媽媽每次打電話都叫她「我親愛的」，她感謝我對 Paula 這麼好。透過這次經驗，我學到人際能力不只是工作上才需要。現在我和 Paula 一起分擔房租、煮飯，也分享彼此的故事，城市生活也變得有趣多了。

questions.questionZh: 作者和 Paula 一開始為什麼很少說話？
options: Paula 比較喜歡跟自己的朋友來往
作者每天工作太忙，很晚才回家
她們剛搬進去就吵過架

questions.questionZh: 這段經驗讓作者學到什麼？
options: 住在城市的開銷實在太貴了
以後不要再跟別人合租
人際能力不只是工作上才需要

referenceEn: My roommate and I get along very well.
I get along really well with my roommate.
rubricZh: roommate 指「室友」（例如 my roommate）
「相處得很好」可寫 get along well、get on well 等

items.promptZh: 做銷售的人需要很強的人際能力。
referenceEn: People who work in sales need strong interpersonal skills.
Sales staff need to have good interpersonal skills.
rubricZh: interpersonal 是形容詞，放在名詞前（例如 interpersonal skills 等）
「做銷售的人」可寫，例如 people who work in sales、sales staff 等
「很強的」可寫，例如 strong、good、excellent 等
